notes.title: Agent Simulator released on App lab
notes.notes:
"Hello Agent Candidates! 🌟 The time has come to dive into the world of Agent Simulation. We're excited to announce that the game is now available in the App Lab! We hope you enjoy this early version and invite you to share your experiences with us.

We plan to update the game regularly on App Lab. While a Steam release isn't on the immediate horizon, we are aiming to have the game ready by the end of the year. However, please note that we cannot confirm an exact date just yet.

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for joining us on this thrilling journey!

notes.title: Gamescom 2023
notes.notes:
"Hello everyone,

The time has come to meet new agent candidates. We are still diligently working on the Agent Simulator. Excitingly, we will be attending Gamescom from August 23rd to 26th. Our goal is to introduce a short demo, gather valuable feedback, and aim to finalize the game by Q4 of this year.

Initially, our plan is to release the game exclusively for the Quest platform. Once we are confident that everything is polished and well-optimized, we will subsequently release it on Steam. Throughout this development phase, we've leveraged the insights gained from our experience creating various successful mobile games. One of our games has even achieved top-chart rankings in multiple countries. We're eager to apply this newfound knowledge to enhance the Agent Simulator experience.

You may have noticed that we've changed the game's name from 'Agent Simulation' to 'Agent Simulator.' This new name is not only more intuitive but also easier for a wider audience to grasp. Our immediate vision for the game is to provide approximately two hours of engaging gameplay right from the start. As time progresses, we have ambitious plans to evolve and enhance the game based on its performance.

Expect continuous improvements and additional content updates in the future, tailored to the game's performance and player feedback.

We invite you to join us at Gamescom 2023. If you're interested in trying out the game firsthand, we encourage you to pay us a visit.

See you at Gamescom 2023!"

notes.title: Htc Vive support added
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, We added small update to demo. We added support for htc vive inputs. You can change inputs from steam vr inputs. We also improved some visuals and  fix some bugs. just tell us your ideas.

Thanks.

notes.title: Steam page and demo is Live
notes.notes: This is our second game, so I'm very excited. We want to share it more actively, but at an early stage. Our first goal is to update the game with your feedback. For now, the demo explains the basic principle of the game. You will play the action moments of an agent in the form of flashbacks. Since it is a very open-ended game, it is open to all kinds of new ideas. We will also accept ideas from you. The game is kind of repetitive, but we will break it as much as we can. Our current plan is that the game will be released in December, but this may change. For now, there is no htc vive support, but it will come with the first demo update. I hope you enjoy the game. If you write your thoughts, it motivates us. Thanks
